title: Updating the Width-Check Pointer
statement: Let a state consist of fifteen natural-number registers, ordered as the query length, pair-scan pointer, input length, scratch register, loop counter, radius, vertex exponent, twice the vertex count, twice its square, width cap, width-check pointer, index, decoding scratch, source vertex, and shift scratch. Replacing the eleventh coordinate of its register vector by a natural number $v$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting its width-check pointer to $v$.
hypotheses_covered: a state with fifteen natural-number registers
